rc16.scope: MD Dark 2026-08-09 payload refresh + rc15fix metadata consistency hardening; MF Uname production set retained
changes: MD embedded production sysupgrade replaced with Dark patched LuCI-enabled build c6f06fcf... size 13226255; automatic transition FIT repinned/rebuilt for that exact image

MD stock-recovery initramfs now derives kernel/rootfs from the operator-selected Dark image a8e24301..., while MedveFlasher rebuilds only the recovery DT to preserve all_flash RO, writable BL2 only in recovery, and ibu restore geometry
MF production UBI initramfs/sysupgrade/preloader/FIP remain the Uname build set; no cross-builder substitution
MF EVB BootROM preloader/FIP remain bundled/offline pins c2ac1c18.../b2f5f93f...; refreshed exact-byte pair was HW-confirmed by the RC16 full stock-restore run on 2026-08-12

fixed stale rc15fix MF transition_fit_totalsize metadata and added verify_kit regression checks binding MANIFEST size/SHA/FIT totalsize/FIT SHA/production metadata to all four shipped transition bundles
removed the unused stale MF snapshot-initramfs pin from the active recovery metadata contract
RC15 transition writable-BL2/production read-only-BL2, pinned BL2 provenance gate, BL2-last order and stage2 SSH/Telnet/FAILED handling are retained unchanged for MF
build QA validates LuCI presence in both MD Dark and MF Uname production sysupgrade files before release packaging
rc16.safety: No runtime recovery downloads. Destructive writes remain behind backup/profile/layout gates; IBU/UBI is verified before BL2, and BL2 is written last.

rc17.scope: control-plane/monitoring/restore UX hardening; production payload bytes unchanged from RC16
changes: content-identified ASCII transition status/log endpoint over HTTP; SSH/Telnet remain fallback transports
raw TCP 22/23/80/443 reachability is debug telemetry only and never identifies transition or production state
one controlled pre-destructive power-cycle suggestion is allowed only after transition SAFE_TO_POWER_CYCLE=1 and before any destructive step 1/8 is observed
Restore Stock is family-bound to the validated MD/MF backup and accepts the matching production/recovery board layout
START exposes brick BootROM/UART recovery before stock Web autodetection
on-device shell payloads are ASCII/English; operator RU/EN localization remains PC-side
strong production success requires expected board, canonical UBI volumes, OpenWrt release identity, and LuCI HTTP content validation
auto-transition FIT root/kernel release identity updated to RC17; destructive installer command logic is unchanged apart from ASCII control-plane/web-log mirroring
rc17.hardware_evidence: RC16 2026-08-12 HW-confirmed MF refreshed EVB recovery and permanent install end-to-end. RC17 auto-transition binary delta is statically validated and awaits a regression run on hardware.
rc17.payload_policy: MD Dark production sysupgrade and MF Uname production UBI/bootloader payload bytes are unchanged from RC16.

rc17fix4_recovery_dt_hardening: Both MD and MF stock-recovery FITs now use recovery-specific DTs: all_flash RO, BL2 writable only in RAM recovery, mtd2=ibu with no linux,ubi pre-restore auto-attach, and Ethernet MAC NVMEM bound to read-only raw stock RI at 0x05200000+0x3e. MF recovery no longer reuses its production DT. Manual readiness removes the approximate /proc/net/route fallback; optional content-based HTTP status is consumed before SSH becomes usable.
rc17fix5_lan_safety_policy: LAN1/2.5G is intentionally excluded from every MD/MF transition and RAM-recovery environment because it is unstable for recovery/control-plane use. Build-time patcher disables the 2500base-x MAC in DT, removes its netdev/NVMEM binding, and replaces initramfs 02_network so only LAN2/LAN3/LAN4 are used. Production sysupgrade images remain unchanged.

rc18_recovery_safe_uboot.policy: U-Boot banner != prompt. Recovery BL33 must be non-autobooting by construction; persistent NAND environment cannot override safe defaults; PC must prove SAFE marker + nonce before NAND capability.
rc18_recovery_safe_uboot.hardware_status: exact RC18 safe FIP bytes pending hardware regression
rc18_recovery_safe_uboot.compression_contract: BL33 uses canonical Airoha LZMA-Alone: known uncompressed size, no EOPM. Runtime preflight pins exact FIP+compressed BL31/BL33 SHA256 and does not decode BL33 on the operator PC.
rc18_recovery_safe_uboot.packaging_correction: The first RC18 archive used Python FORMAT_ALONE output with EOPM and then rewrote the size field; strict Windows liblzma rejected it before COM/XMODEM. Corrected RC18 rebuild uses LZMA1EXT without EOPM.

rc19_restore_transport_hardening.historical_client_provenance: Pinned minimal AArch64 recovery clients restored from the pre-Dark recovery lineage. This is a TFTP GET client, not a tftpd server; the PC-side Python TFTP server remains authoritative.
rc19_restore_transport_hardening.ssh_policy: Transient root is intentionally blank; Dropbear is launched with -B. master.py prefers deterministic none-auth SSH for recovery and ignores operator known_hosts.
rc19_restore_transport_hardening.write_state_policy: Transport fallback is permitted only before the SSH command containing mtd write is issued. Any disconnect/error after issue is WRITE_STATE_UNKNOWN and stops the workflow for read-only re-identification; no second write transport is attempted automatically.
rc19_restore_transport_hardening.production_payloads: MD Dark and MF Uname production sysupgrade tails remain byte-identical to RC18.
rc19_restore_transport_hardening.known_md_initramfs_issue: Known upstream MD initramfs kernel panics remain tracked separately; production/sysupgrade kernel behavior is not rolled back.

rc22_bad_block_aware_uboot_restore.scope: BootROM/UART direct stock restore for MD/MF
rc22_bad_block_aware_uboot_restore.root_cause: fixed 8 MiB U-Boot mtd writes crossed bad eraseblocks; U-Boot skipped bad blocks and compacted the stream, so the next nominal chunk could overlap previously written physical NAND
gates: mtd bad bl2 must be empty before any erase/write
mtd bad ubi parsed and erase-aligned before destructive confirmation
bad blocks inside canonical stock span are allowed only in stock UBI-backed config/data/oopsfs/log_truncated physical range 0x052C0000..0x0EB60000
bad-block map is rescanned after whole-ubi erase before first IBU write
each 8 MiB source chunk is split into contiguous good physical spans; RAM and destination offsets advance identically so known bad PEBs create holes, never compaction
each good span is read back and CRC32 verified
bad-block map must remain stable across all body writes/readbacks
BL2 remains LAST and is never written if body verification or bad-block map stability fails
rc22_bad_block_aware_uboot_restore.hardware_trigger_failure: RC21 failed at IBU 13/30 readback ubi+0x06000800 with -74 after chunk 12 crossed three marked bad eraseblocks
rc22_bad_block_aware_uboot_restore.hardware_result: Real MF: physical good-span write/readback completed and stock main image/kernel booted, but stock data UBIFS failed ubifs_recover_master_node and entered watchdog reboot. Do not classify exact RC22 bad-block restore as full HW PASS.

rc23_timestamp_backup_identity.console_timestamps: local YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS on operator lines/prompts
rc23_timestamp_backup_identity.backup_mac_source: eth0 preferred; first non-loopback sysfs interface fallback

rc24_interactive_navigation.behavior: interactive actions no longer terminate master.py on normal completion or ordinary recoverable errors; operator chooses back to section, main menu, or exit
rc24_interactive_navigation.invalid_selection: re-prompt in place, including startup mode selection
rc24_interactive_navigation.safety: WRITE_STATE_UNKNOWN raises a process-local SAFETY-LATCH that blocks normal install/no-UART restore/destructive continuation; successful full BootROM/UART recovery clears the latch; no automatic destructive retry is introduced
rc24_interactive_navigation.cli_contract: direct subcommands retain ordinary process exit codes and are not wrapped by menu recovery
